text:
Rules
Choose your fantasy team name, colour, logo and roster in the Google Sheet. (If you want some inspiration for your draft, you can check out the team generator)     🔴🟡🔵Team Colour: Valid hexadecimal colour code     👩‍👩‍👧📷🖥️Team Image: Valid link to any image on the web Your team should have exactly the following (the Google Sheet dropdowns force this structure, don’t worry!):     🏒 6 forwards     🛡️ 4 defenders     🥅 2 goalies 😮‍💨 Players/goalies aren’t restricted to a single fantasy team so if someone took a player you like, you can take them too! ↔︎️ Trades: Throughout the season, you are allowed exactly 1 trade (respecting the team structure). Your new player only contributes points to your fantasy score starting the day after the trade. Please let Alex or Noah know directly if/when you make a trade! 🕐 Deadline: You can use all of November’s pre-season and regular season games to scout your roster and aim to lock it in by November 30th, 2025! After this date, the Google Sheet will be 👁️View Only👁️ 💰💵💸 Prize pool (Optional): E-transfer $10 to Alex or Noah to enter in the fantasy prize pool! More information TBD but you could WIN BIGGGG! (Send an e-transfer or intent to e-transfer by the roster deadline to enter the prize pool)


Scoring
Your fantasy team’s score is updated daily with data from the previous day’s games. Each day, each member of your fantasy roster will contribute a number of points to your team’s overall score, following the scheme below:







Skaters
Goalies




🏒 2 pts/goal🤝 1 pt/assist🎯 0.1 pts/shot⛔ 0.1 pts/blocked shot✨ 2 pts/win*😖 0 pts/loss*🥇 1 pt/OT loss*
🧱 1 pt/shutout⛔ 0.05 pts/save✨ 2 pts/win*😖 0 pts/loss*🥇 1 pt/OT loss*



You can check how your and everyone else’s teams are doing here. Note that eventually, only regular season games will contribute to your fantasy teams score.
*Note that if your play did not play in a game in which their team won, they will not contribute points to your score (this includes dressed goalies that did not get subbed in).

title: Fantasy Draft Data
text:
For the 2026-2027 season, we are making two changes to changes to the fantasy league regarding fantasy points and fantasy team drafting. First, the new structure for scoring fantasy points is as follows:
Second, all PWHL players will be assigned a Fantasy Draft Value (FDV), and a Value Cap will be imposed to the fantasy teams that will be drafted this year. The FDV will be computed based on the new fantasy point structure applied retroactively to the 2025-2026 season.

title: Fantasy Draft Data
text:
Assigning the FDV
The FDV will be assigned differently based on whether the player is a new rookie in the upcoming season. In each case however, instead of looking at Fantasy Points (FP) earned last year, we look at the Projected Fantasy Points (PFP) earned last year. The PFP are defined as follows:
\[
\text{PFP} = 30 * \frac{\text{FP}}{\text{GP}},
\]
where \(GP:=\) games played.
We take the average number of FP earned per game played and multiply that by the total number of games in a season for one team (30) to estimate how many FP would have been earned if the player played every game of the season.

Non-rookie
If the player is not a rookie, the FDV is is simply the player’s earned PFP last season, rounded to the nearest integer.








Rookie
Assigning FDVs to rookies is done by comparing the draft position of the upcoming rookie cohort with the performance of the rookies last season. Each rookie’s FDV is computed as follows:
\[
\text{FDV} = \text{round}\left(0.6 * \text{PFP}_{\text{max,rookie}} * \frac{\text{N}_\text{rookie} - \text{pos}_\text{draft} + 1}{\text{N}_\text{rookie}}\right),
\]
where:

\(\text{PFP}_{\text{max,rookie}}:=\) maximum PFP amongst all rookies last year
\(\text{N}_\text{rookie}:=\) number of new rookies this year
\(\text{pos}_\text{draft}:=\) position of rookie in draft order (integer from \(\{1,\ldots,\text{N}_\text{rookie}\}\))

The factor of 0.6 accounts for the risk of drafting a new rookie to a fantasy team.
During the 2025-2025 season, the \(\text{PFP}_{\text{max,rookie}}\) was 46.43 obtained by Kristýna Kaltounková, which yields the following FDVs for the new rookies of the 2026-2027 season:
